title.suggested: Stakes in Old-Time Prize Fights, Including Allen's

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reviewed prize-fight stakes since 1776, noting Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole near St. Louis in 1873 for $2,000 and lost the championship and $5,000 to Joe Goss in 1876.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, April 23, 1893, page 26.

facts.fact: Allen beat Mike McCoole in seven rounds (twenty minutes) near St. Louis in 1873 for stakes of $2,000
Allen won $2,000 stakes by defeating Charley Gallagher
Jem Mace beat Allen at New Orleans in ten rounds for $5,000 (the paper says 1871)
Joe Goss took the championship and $5,000 from Allen in 1876, winning on a foul in Kentucky after twenty-one rounds

notes: Allen is one paragraph of a long general history. The paper dates the Mace fight 1871; it is usually given as May 1870 at Kennerville near New Orleans.
